title: Atomic Energy Commission 'born secret' restricted data

tellings.quote: The Atomic Energy Commission outlined this sort of restricted data where if you were to collect anything that had any radiological features, alpha, beta, gamma radiation, it would be born secret.

plain: Michels says the Atomic Energy Commission, set up in 1946 to run American nuclear work, created a category called restricted data under which anything collected with radiological features, meaning alpha, beta or gamma radiation, was "born secret": classified from the moment it existed, with no one needing to stamp it. He tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode on Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, as a way that evidence with radiation traces could have been kept secret automatically.
